clue.text: Burn plan to release tension

explanation.surface: A tip for stressed people: burn your plans to let the tension go.
explanation.definitionFit: To char is to scorch or blacken by burning, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Booklet, brown and orange-yellow, about Clemenceau's end

parts.note: Georges Clemenceau, French prime minister in the First World War; his name supplies its final letter

explanation.surface: Describes a pamphlet on Clemenceau's final years, printed in brown and orange-yellow.
explanation.definitionFit: A brochure is a small booklet or pamphlet, usually promotional.

clue.text: America's on edge, I say!

explanation.definitionFit: Ahem is the throat-clearing interjection used to get attention, much like saying 'I say!'

clue.text: It's instrumental in making a brand of beer, 'Devil's Head Grog'

explanation.walkthrough: Bass is a British brewery brand, famous for its red triangle logo.

clue.text: Sporting object producing endless debate

parts.note: to discuss is to debate

explanation.definitionFit: A discus is the heavy disc thrown in athletics, an object used in sport.

clue.text: Electrons hit with one will be shut in

parts.note: taken as written
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.definitionFit: To encloister is to shut someone away in a cloister, confining them.

clue.text: Remove moisture around electronic circuit leads

indicators.note: the moisture word goes around the other letters

parts.note: damp is moisture

parts.note: words whose first letters are used

explanation.definitionFit: To decamp is to leave or move away suddenly; remove here means to move oneself elsewhere.

clue.text: State without a health centre

parts.note: the run of letters across these three words holds the state's name

explanation.walkthrough: 'health centre' reads as a clinic; 'centre' is actually the signal to look inside the words.
explanation.definitionFit: Utah is one of the fifty states of the USA.

clue.text: Bitter Roger's getting into mess

clue.text: Food wrapping ultimately going sodden — the making of a row

indicators.note: ultimately points to the last letters of the words

parts.note: words whose final letters are used

explanation.walkthrough: 'row' tempts as a quarrel, but here it is a line of things.
explanation.definitionFit: Alignment is the arrangement of things in a straight line, which is how a row is made.

clue.text: Queen's thing is to roll back amount by one hundred

explanation.walkthrough: Queen is the rock band, not the monarch; their thing is rock music.
explanation.definitionFit: The band Queen played rock, so rock music was their genre or 'thing'.

clue.text: Director's left with instructor about to quit

clue.text: Apart from a second subordinate

parts.note: taken as written
someone under another is subordinate to them

explanation.definitionFit: Asunder means into separate pieces or apart, as in torn asunder.

clue.text: Top of Bowfell, on ascending after morning light

parts.note: re means about or on, as in letters

explanation.definitionFit: Amber is the middle traffic light, between red and green.

clue.text: Perhaps a local date on musical instrument associated with cathedral city

York, home of York Minster

explanation.walkthrough: A local is British slang for one's regular pub, and the Duke of York is a common pub name.
explanation.definitionFit: The Duke of York is a frequent British pub name, so it is an example of a local.

clue.text: Boxer in training, possibly has splendid start with breakfast item

parts.note: the word whose first letter is used

clue.text: Man, say, with working material

on means operating or working

explanation.surface: A man at work with his materials.

clue.text: In trouble, a king's miserable

clue.text: Not talking about abandoning book is slander!

about turns the word around

parts.note: dumb means silent, not talking

clue.text: Suffering, so tear hair out?

explanation.definitionFit: Distress is anguish or suffering; split up it reads as removing tresses, a lock of hair.

clue.text: As a bit of a shock, trade union measure has satisfactory conclusion

parts.note: FT, foot, a unit of length

parts.note: the word whose final letter is used

clue.text: Struggle of establishment figure to absorb Latin

clue.text: Charging aids pack and switches

clue.text: Character to sing about hairstyle

clue.text: Revered area of land divides a US state

clue.text: Iron is moulded round large cut

clue.text: Dessert that's put before baby?

clue.text: A target on the green flag
